newsitem.title: USA: Virginia Power sees Surry 2 back by weekend.
newsitem.headline: Virginia Power sees Surry 2 back by weekend.

text.p: Virginia Power said Wednesday it would likely restart its 781 megawatt (MW) Surry 2 nuclear power unit before the weekend after manually shutting it Tuesday for repairs.
"We anticipate to restart the unit before the weekend," a company spokesman said.
The utility decided to take Surry 2 in Gravel Neck, Va., off line about 1500 EST Tuesday after an electrical loss to the turbine's electrical hydraulic control system.
"We manually shut the unit yesterday when we detected a loss of electrical power to a panel that controls valves which governs steam from the generator to the turbine," a company spokesman said.
Those regulating valves, which are open during normal operation, began shutting when power flow was disrupted, he added.
The adjoining unit 1, also at 781 MW, continued to produce at 100 percent output, the spokesman said.
Virgina Power is a subsidiary of Dominion Resources.
